intro: Falla Sagewind is a reclusive tauren mystic perched high upon a rocky peak overlooking the central Barrens. Stationed between the Crossroads and the Lushwater Oasis, she studies the natural and mystical anomalies troubling the surrounding land. Adventurers probing the twisted corruption seeping from the nearby Wailing Caverns often seek her guidance.

p: Falla Sagewind makes her camp far above the dust and bustle of the Barrens trails, situated on a secluded summit just southwest of the Crossroads. From this vantage, she keeps a solemn watch over the fragile savannas below, observing the sudden shifts in wildlife behavior and the encroaching corruption rising from the subterranean fissures of the Wailing Caverns. Her solitary vigil separates her from the daily trade of the Crossroads, positioning her as an observant hermit tuned to the spirits and the land's silent wounds.
